explanation: Added the `new` keyword when instantiating the Stripe client to comply with the v22.0.0 ES6 class constructor requirement.
Updated stripe.customers.retrieve to pass the apiKey via the RequestOptions object instead of as a plain string argument.
Converted the listCustomers function to use async/await since callback support was removed in v22.0.0.
Renamed stripe.parseThinEvent to stripe.parseEventNotification according to the v19.0.0 SDK breaking change.
Updated `Stripe.webhooks().constructEvent` to `Stripe.webhooks.constructEvent` to comply with version 18.0.0 where webhooks is a plain object instead of a factory function.
Renamed usage_threshold_config to usage_threshold on Billing.AlertCreateParams in accordance with SDK v17.0.0.
Renamed volume_decimal to quantity_decimal in the fuel purchase details object per the v16.0.0 SDK breaking change.
Renamed the Stripe invoice method from listUpcomingLineItems to listUpcomingLines to match the v10.0.0 SDK breaking change.
Replaced the removed retrieveDetails method with a TODO comment and a thrown Error indicating the removal in version v10.0.0.
Updated stripe.checkoutSessions to stripe.checkout.sessions.create to reflect the rename and namespacing in v6.21.0.
Added a TODO comment above the removed expires_after field read for v22.7.0-alpha.4 as it has no replacement.
Renamed usage_threshold_config to usage_threshold on the billing alert object.
Added optional chaining to the transition read since it is now optional.
